summary: Code review passed. Test suite follows PHPUnit 12 best practices throughout: final class, CoversClass, DataProvider, createStub, assertSame. Per-test temp directory isolation prevents cross-test conflicts. TestableBaseComicSource correctly minimises abstract stubs. One minor non-blocking coverage gap (stale episode ID in preserved map not explicitly tested). Two gold-nugget observations recorded.

comments.note: No explicit test for a preserved episode ID that has no matching entry in the current indexEntries (stale/deleted episode). The production code handles it correctly via the !isset check + continue, but a test confirming that stale keys are silently dropped would complete the contract documentation. Non-blocking.

Test 4 (doesNotOverwriteFreshlyFetchedKeys) correctly verifies BOTH sides of the merge contract in a single case: the fresh key wins AND the non-conflicting preserved key is still merged. This two-assertion structure is the right way to test the precedence rule.

7-case filterText DataProvider includes the subtle 'pure whitespace blanked' edge case: trim('   ') = '' and is_numeric('') is false, so the empty string is returned. Including this as an explicit named case prevents future maintainers from misunderstanding the function as 'blanks numeric strings and returns empty for empty input via numeric check'.

summary: Test files are self-documenting via PHPUnit naming conventions (CoversClass, DataProvider, assertSame, descriptive method names). No inline documentation changes required.
